[All pages](README.md).

### [`faq-open.ts`](../../lib/analytics/faq-open.ts)

- `faqPositionAttributes` _function_: The attribute to spread onto the `<details>` of the question at 0-based `index`.
- `faqOpenedPositionOf` _function_: The position a `toggle` on `target` reports: the question's place when an FAQ row opened, `null` for a row that closed and for any other `<details>`.
- `FAQ_POSITION_ATTRIBUTE` _const_: The attribute carrying a question's 1-based place in its list.

### [`foreground-timer.ts`](../../lib/analytics/foreground-timer.ts)

- `ForegroundTimer` _class_: The time one page view spent in the foreground: it runs while the page is visible and stands still while the tab is hidden, so a page left open in the background earns nothing.
- `MAX_ENGAGEMENT_SECONDS` _const_: The most foreground seconds one page view reports; a tab left open all day counts no more.

### [`internal-link.ts`](../../lib/analytics/internal-link.ts)

- `isLinkBlock` _function_: Whether a string read off the DOM is a block the event knows.
- `linkBlockAttributes` _function_: The attribute to spread onto the element that holds a block's links.
- `linkEntityAttributes` _function_: The attribute to spread onto a card's wrapper inside a block, so a click on the card names the park or ride it opens. Nothing for an id that is not a UUID.
- `internalLinkClickOf` _function_: The `internal_link_clicked` a click on `target` makes, or `null`: a click on a link of this site inside a marked block.
- `LINK_BLOCK_ATTRIBUTE` _const_: The attribute that marks an element as a block of links and names it.
- `LINK_ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE` _const_: The attribute carrying the UUID of the park or ride a card inside a block links to.
- Types: `LinkBlock`, `InternalLinkClick`

### [`opt-out.ts`](../../lib/analytics/opt-out.ts)

- `isAnalyticsHost` _function_: Whether a page on `hostname` may be counted at all.
- `privacySignal` _function_: The do-not-count signal this browser sends, if any: Do Not Track in both spellings browsers use, or Global Privacy Control (the API refuses `Sec-GPC` as well).
- `analyticsOptedOut` _function_: Whether this browser asked not to be counted by our page-view counter: a `privacySignal` or the opt-out on the privacy page. Storage that cannot be read counts as no flag.
- `ANALYTICS_OPT_OUT_KEY` _const_: The localStorage flag that keeps this browser out of the statistics when `'1'`. Named for Umami's tracker, which read it, so an opt-out set while Umami ran still holds.
- `ANALYTICS_HOSTS` _const_: The hosts that count: production only, never a preview or a local build.

### [`outbound-link.ts`](../../lib/analytics/outbound-link.ts)

Where an outbound link goes, the closed list of the event's `target`.

- `isOutboundTarget` _function_: Whether a string read off the DOM is a target the API accepts.
- `outboundLinkAttributes` _function_: The attributes to spread onto an `<a>` that leaves the site; `entity` is the park's UUID.
- `OUTBOUND_ATTRIBUTE` _const_: The attribute that marks an anchor as outbound and names its target.
- `OUTBOUND_ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE` _const_: The attribute carrying the UUID of the park the link belongs to.
- Types: `OutboundTarget`

### [`page-views.ts`](../../lib/analytics/page-views.ts)

- `shouldCountPageView` _function_: Whether this read should be counted at all: the gates of the site statistic (production's hosts, not automation, not Do Not Track, Global Privacy Control or the opt-out), and not twice from one tab.
- `sendPageView` _function_: Counts one read as the `page_read` event of the site statistic. A post is named by its key; a park or a ride is the event's entity, its UUID.
- `PAGE_VIEW_DWELL_MS` _const_: How long a page has to be in front of the reader before it counts as read.
- Types: `PageViewKind`

### [`planner-funnel.ts`](../../lib/analytics/planner-funnel.ts)

- `trackPlannerOpened` _function_: Counts `planner_opened` with its `source` on the closed to open edge of the planner panel, the top of the funnel, and starts an opening. `source` is the one property, because which way in earns its place is the decision it answers.
- `trackPlannerClosed` _function_: Counts `planner_closed_empty` when the panel closes and no day gained its first block in that opening, at most once per opening. No property: `planner_opened` already carries the way in.
- `trackPlanDayStarted` _function_: Counts `plan_day_started` when a park and date gain their first block, not on finishing the wizard and not per added ride, and marks the running opening as having started a day.
- `planItemOf` _function_: What a stored block is, and the slug its entity is looked up by.
- `trackPlanItemAdded` _function_: Counts `plan_item_added`: one block into a plan, from `source`.
- `trackPlanItemRemoved` _function_: Counts `plan_item_removed`: one block out of a plan, through `source`.
- `trackPlanOptimized` _function_: Counts `plan_optimized` for a re-plan that changed the day, with what did it.
- `trackPlannerFitOpened` _function_: Counts `planner_fit_opened`: the fit assistant asked its question.
- `trackPlannerFitLever` _function_: Counts `planner_fit_lever` when a lever is switched on; switching it off counts nothing.
- `trackPlannerUndo` _function_: Counts `planner_undo`: a day put back from `source`'s snapshot.
- `trackPlannerDayCleared` _function_: Counts `planner_day_cleared`: a whole day dropped.
- `trackSharedPlanOpened` _function_: Counts `planner_shared_opened` once the shared plan's answer is in.
- `trackSharedPlanAdopted` _function_: Counts `planner_shared_adopted`: the shared plan taken over.
- `trackPlannerPushOn` _function_: Counts `planner_push_on`: push for the plan on, with the API's acceptance.
- `createPlannerWizardSession` _function_: A `PlannerWizardSession` sending through `send`. Plain state: nothing renders from it.
- Types: `PlannerEventSender`, `PlannerWizardSession`

### [`search-session.ts`](../../lib/analytics/search-session.ts)

- `createSearchSession` _function_: A `SearchSession` for `surface`, sending through `send`. Plain state rather than React state: nothing renders from it, and the events must not wait for a commit.
- `searchResultData` _function_: The attributes that mark a link as a search result for `trackResultClick`, for lists a Server Component draws (`/search`) or that take no callback (`PostSearchResultList`).
- `trackResultClick` _function_: Sends `search_result_clicked` for a click inside a list marked with `searchResultData`: one capture listener on the list instead of a handler per row.
- `SEARCH_SETTLE_MS` _const_: How long a query has to hold still to count as settled: the palette's debounce, and the wait a field without one gives its query before `search_typed` and `search_no_results`.
- Types: `SearchEventName`, `SearchEventProps`, `SearchEventSender`, `SearchSession`

### [`section-seen.ts`](../../lib/analytics/section-seen.ts)

The places a park page marks, top to bottom, the closed list of the event's `section`.

- `isSeenSection` _function_: Whether a string read off the DOM is a place the event knows.
- `SECTION_SEEN_ATTRIBUTE` _const_: The attribute that makes an element a mark and names its place.
- Types: `SeenSection`

### [`site-analytics.ts`](../../lib/analytics/site-analytics.ts)

- `sitePageTypeOf` _function_: The page type of a locale-prefixed path such as `/de/parks/europe/germany/bruehl/phantasialand`.
- `searchPosition` _function_: The bucket of a 1-based result position.
- `canCountSite` _function_: Whether this tab may send anything: production hosts only, not from automation or a simulated visit, not under Do Not Track, Global Privacy Control or the privacy page's opt-out.
- `flushSiteAnalytics` _function_: Sends what is queued now instead of in a second. The page does it on its own when it is hidden; this is for a caller that cannot wait for that, such as a test.
- `trackSitePageview` _function_: Counts a view of the page now in the address bar. Call once per navigation. The view before it ends here, so the foreground time it has not reported yet is queued ahead of the new pageview, under the path and page type it was opened with.
- `markPageNotFound` _function_: Declares the page in the address bar a "not found" page, which only that page knows: its pageview becomes `not_found`, whether it was queued already or comes after.
- `trackSiteEvent` _function_: Counts one event on the current page. A name in `SiteEventMap` is checked against its properties; any other name (lower case, digits and underscores, two to 48 characters) goes through with any properties of `SiteEventProps`.
- Types: `SitePageType`, `SearchSurface`, `SearchResultKind`, `SearchPosition`, `NavMenuId`, `SearchBrowseItem`, `PlannerWizardStep`, `PlanItemKind`, `PlanItemAddSource`, `PlanItemRemoveSource`, `PlanOptimizeMode`, `PlannerFitSource`, `PlannerFitLever`, `PlannerUndoSource`, `SharedPlanResult`, `SiteEventMap`, `SiteEventName`, `AttractionFilterName`

### [`umami.ts`](../../lib/analytics/umami.ts)

The one way an event reaches Umami, a no-op while Umami is switched off (the layout embeds no tracker, see docs/development/analytics.md).

- `trackEvent` _function_: Sends one event to Umami, or nothing when the script is not loaded. Every property is billed as an extra event; see the budget at the top of this file before adding one.
- `UMAMI_BEFORE_SEND` _const_: The global function the tracker's `data-before-send` names; the layout defines it first.
- `UMAMI_BEFORE_SEND_SCRIPT` _const_: Defines `UMAMI_BEFORE_SEND`: a page with a query string reaches Umami without its title. The search page puts the query in its title, and `data-exclude-search` strips only the URL and the next page's referrer.
